//: Matcher evidence request, read by .github/workflows/matcher-evidence.yml. A change to this file on main (a merge) runs the request once; the scheduled windows read the collect section. Read-only provider access; no Upstash writes; automatic matching stays off. See docs/exec-plans/HUMAN_LABOR_ELIMINATION.md.

replay.//: Passive Shadow v3 evidence of record. The raw artifact expires 2026-10-09T06:28:03Z; this job also copies it into a 90-day artifact and the private evidence vault.

collect.//: One bounded window per scheduled run. Pools rotate by weekday so windows cover different route families and time bands. A pool that finds no route with vehicles falls back to pool 0, whose route IDs are verified live.
